name: Self Centered
overview: Scripture reveals that being self centered is marked by a refusal to seek God, as the wicked do not have God in their thoughts and act as if there is no God (Psalms 10:4). This self-focused mindset is described as carnal and hostile toward God, unable to submit to His law (Romans 8:7). In contrast, God's love is demonstrated through the giving of His Son, calling believers away from self-centeredness toward everlasting life through faith (John 3:16).
